interface.shortDescription: Choose the right infrastructure API for an agent task
interface.longDescription: EveryInfra Router is a standalone agent skill for selecting the right EveryInfra infrastructure API. It maps a requested outcome to structured data, web search, AI, authorized captcha, email, phone-number or proxy workflows, then checks the applicable MCP or REST contract before execution. Use this skill when you know the outcome but not the product to call. It is a dispatch guide, not a replacement for a data source, an email transport or a proxy client.
defaultPrompt: I need public data about a set of businesses. Decide whether this is an EveryData or EverySearch task; inspect capabilities before proposing calls.
Plan a workflow to find current product documentation and draft an email summary. Do not send the email or buy anything.
This request combines text classification and a proxy. Identify the required products and permission boundaries without placing an order.
